description: Protection Paladin-style tank - two parallel builder/spender pairs (Starburst/Starsweep for AoE, Starsunder/Lunar Lance for single target), with every block/parry/dodge feeding the kit.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available (Command, Eclipse of Fury, Lunar Authority, Celestial Aegis confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: blocking seeds Scattered Stars (Nebula), avoiding attacks calls unavoidable Moonflares, parrying refunds Energy and hits back - tanking well IS dealing damage.

nodes.name: Moon Guard
nodes.description: Grants Spell Power equal to 50% of your Strength.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Grants Intellect equal to Strength.'

nodes.name: Virtue
nodes.description: Increases Attack Power scaling from Agility by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Starburst Invigoration
nodes.description: Starburst has a 20% chance per rank to invigorate you, restoring 10 Energy.

nodes.name: Endless Sky
nodes.description: Increases Stamina and maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Crystal Shield
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 2% and grants Spell Power equal to 5% of your Attack Power, per rank.
nodes._source:
spell_damage_taken_pct: -0.07 REMOVED 2026-10-28 on Kyle's direction to follow the CoA reference over earlier guidance. I added it that morning on the brief that Moon Guard is a magic tank, and it was wrong three ways: the real CoA Crystal Shield is 'Level 30 Passive. Increases your Stamina by 10% and increases your spell damage by 25% of your attack power' with no mitigation clause at all; -7% x 5 ranks gave this spec -35% magic damage taken, seven times the magic reduction in the entire Starcaller class tree (Constellation Barrier -5%, Mu'sha's Resilience -15% Arcane only); and it was never in the node's own tooltip, so a player could not see it.

Moon Guard is CoA's 'Closest to Protection Paladin' - a PARRY and BLOCK tank whose damage comes FROM avoidance (Moonflares fire on avoided attacks, Nebula seeds stars on blocks, parries refund Energy and strike back). Its stat priority is Defense > Stamina > Hit/Expertise > Parry > Dodge > Block. Its survivability now comes from those procs actually firing on blocks and parries, which they could not before the on_block/on_parry triggers existed. Magnitudes here match CoA: 2% x 5 = 10% Stamina, 5% x 5 = 25% of attack power as spell power.

nodes.name: Moonflares
nodes.description: Avoiding an attack calls down a Moonflare on the attacker for 18 Arcane damage per rank. No more than once per turn.
nodes._source:
Was 'Starlord's Mandate', an invented node. Replaced with CoA's real Moonflares: 'Avoiding melee attacks will call down a Moonflare at the attacker, dealing 66 Arcane damage. Can occur only once per second.'

This is the signature node of the whole spec and it was missing entirely. CoA's Moon Guard is a tank whose DAMAGE comes from its avoidance - 'Avoiding an attack calls down a Moonflare, an unavoidable Arcane nuke'; 'Tanking well is how you deal damage' - and its stat priority runs Defense > Stamina > Hit/Expertise > PARRY > DODGE > BLOCK. Without this, parry and dodge bought the spec nothing but the avoided hit itself.

Only implementable since the on_avoid trigger was added today: the engine's sole defensive hook was on_damage_taken, which fires when a hit LANDS - the exact opposite event. Per rank rather than CoA's single point, to fit Frontier's tier budget.

nodes.name: Starburst
nodes.description: Learn Starburst, smashing up to 8 enemies for Arcane damage that scales with block value and maximum mana, reducing their attack speed. Applies 1 Scattered Star per hit.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Moon Guard's real AoE builder: 'Smashes up to 8 enemies for Arcane damage (scaling with block value + max mana), reduces attack speed; consuming a star reduces cooldown.'

nodes.name: Nebula
nodes.description: Blocking an attack wraps you in a nebula, granting 60 Armor and 4% block chance for 2 turns. 25% chance per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's real Scattered-Star-off-tanking mechanic: 'Blocking applies Scattered Stars to the attacker.'

nodes.name: Chosen of the Moon
nodes.description: Learn Chosen of the Moon, reducing your physical damage taken and taunting nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Reduces physical damage taken + AoE taunt.' Real named strength - flat physical reduction plus a real AoE taunt in one button.

nodes.name: Blanket of Stars
nodes.description: Increases Block chance by 1% and Block value by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as core mitigation: 'shield-gated block burst,' referenced repeatedly as this spec's primary defensive layer.

nodes.name: Moonlit Bulwark
nodes.description: Learn Moonlit Bulwark, shielding for an amount equal to your maximum mana. Usable while stunned.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Shields for an amount equal to max mana. Usable while stunned.' Analogous to Ardent Defender/Guardian of Ancient Kings per the handoff's retail comparison.

nodes.name: Astral Reconstitution
nodes.description: Taking damage has a 25% chance per rank to reconstitute 40 Mana.

nodes.name: Guarded by the Moon
nodes.description: Starburst and Starsweep guard you with moonlight, increasing block chance by 6% for 3 turns and your threat generation by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Consuming a Scattered Star boosts block chance (stacking).'

nodes.name: Vengeance of Elune
nodes.description: Learn Vengeance of Elune, an unavoidable AoE Arcane hit that scales with Attack Power and Intellect, usable only after parrying.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'AoE Arcane damage (scales with AP + Intellect), unavoidable; only after parrying.' Real parry-punish payoff button.

nodes.name: Asteroid Belt
nodes.description: Your casts have a 15% chance to ring you with an Asteroid Belt, granting 25 Hit rating and 40 Armor Penetration for 3 turns. No more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Periodically grants Asteroid Belt buff; boosts hit rating (from Int) + expertise.' Handoff doc calls this a built-in duty cycle rather than a flat stance.

nodes.name: Coalesced Resilience
nodes.description: The moon's own weight settles over you, reducing all damage you take by 12%.
nodes._source:
Was 'Celestial Impact', an invented capstone unlocking a stun. Replaced with CoA's real Coalesced Resilience: 'Reduces your damage taken by an amount equal to 1% of your maximum mana.'

The audit named this as the spec's actual mitigation capstone, and its absence - together with the missing Moonflares - is why Moon Guard measured last on survival. Max mana is load-bearing armour for this spec in CoA: Moonlit Bulwark shields for a share of max mana, Starburst scales with it, Asteroid Belt scales with mana held. The max_mana_pct here is part of the mechanic, not padding.

NOT FULLY FAITHFUL: mitigation scaling off max mana is not expressible - damage_taken_pct is a flat fraction - so it is a flat -12% plus the mana pool growth that would have fed it.

nodes.name: Starlight Duelist
nodes.description: Turning a blow aside leaves you duelling in starlight, increasing damage dealt by 8% for 2 turns. 30% chance per rank.

nodes.name: Shrouded Stars
nodes.description: Grants the party and raid a damage reduction buff. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage reduction (no stacking with similar).'

nodes.name: Dancing in the Moonlight
nodes.description: Parrying a blow lets you dance aside, refunding 15 Energy. No more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'parrying refunds Energy + hits back (Dancing in the Moonlight).'

nodes.name: Star Pupil
nodes.description: Damaging critical strikes have a 25% chance per rank to make you Elune's pupil, increasing critical strike chance by 4% for 3 turns. No more than once per turn.

nodes.name: Second Moon
nodes.description: Your damage has a 20% chance to call a second moon, launching a free Lunar Lance at the target. No more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real burst payoff: 'Every 10th Scattered Star consumed launches a comet.' Called out in the rotation writeup: 'the spender IS your burst too.'

nodes.name: Starbound
nodes.description: Increases your healing done by 3% per rank. Your heals have a 15% chance per rank to bind a star to you, healing you for 50.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts healing done + received, doubled below 20% health.' Called out as one of Moon Guard's only real heal-facing tools alongside Touch of Moonlight.
